title: Fusion Coil
body:
Description

The Fusion Coil is a quest coil that combines the effects of the Gravity Coil, Speed Coil and Healing Coil.

Appearance

The Fusion Coil uses the same model as the classic Fusion Coil model from Roblox. It also emits a purple glow, similar to Magnetite ore. It is slightly variegated and not uniform in its shades of purple.

Obtaining

  • Navigate to Uncertainty Cave and acquire the Infused Core by getting a Mysterious Mushroom to fire a spore at a regular Meteor Core.
  • Use bombs to detonate the wall blocking the entrance to the Oobmab Lake near the mushroom cave and navigate inside.
  • Place the Infused Core along with the Speed, Gravity, and Healing Coil into the magenta-colored lake.
  • If done correctly, all of the items will begin to emit a sparkling effect and slowly fade away, thus beginning the fusion process. About 40 to 45 seconds after, all of the items will fuse into the Fusion Coil, and it will be able to be claimed. If any of the items belong to different players, they will sparkle but not fuse. All items must be under the same name in order for the coil to fuse.

Note that if the server load is high, the fusion process may take more time than usual.

Trivia

  • Unlike the other coils, the Fusion Coil emits light, which may be useful for traversing dark areas.
  • Having the coil equipped while driving any vehicle applies an anti-gravity effect on the vehicle as well. However, no speed or healing effect is applied. This also works with the Gravity Coil.

New information

  • Fusion coil now can be fused anywhere in a purple lake, going to Oobmab location is not required.
  • You may see the ruins in mysterious cave, they are partially revealing the combination of Fusion coil.
  • When you put first materials, they will start sparkling with white, and go to magenta when you put the rest.
  • Fusion is followed by a dark violet explosion, same as meteor core getting infused.
